Run plays some games.

It is the test tree's leaf.

Usage:
  tool run [flags]

Flags:
  -a string             policy A (default "bot")
      --big int64       an int64
  -g, --games int       games to play (default 1)
      --seed uint64     base seed (default 1)
      --shared string   a root flag every subcommand inherits (default "s0")
      --single          one leg
      --tag strings     tags (repeatable, comma-separated)
      --tol float       tolerance (default 0.001)
      --word word       an upper-cased word (default w)

Global flags:
      --config string   read flag values from this JSON file (env GORGE_TOOL_CONFIG)
  -h, --help            show this help
      --print-config    print the effective configuration as JSON (loadable with --config) and exit

Environment and config:
  Each flag is also read from the environment variable GORGE_TOOL_RUN_<FLAG>
  (upper case, '-' as '_'; e.g. GORGE_TOOL_RUN_A) and from the "run" section of the
  JSON file --config names.
  Inherited flags (--shared) are read from their own command's variable
  and config section (e.g. GORGE_TOOL_SHARED).
  Precedence: flag > environment > config > default; --print-config prints
  the result. A long flag may also be spelled with one dash (-name value),
  as Go's flag package spells it.
